selection_contract.rule: A future owner Continue must reconcile campaign Achievement, onboarding/mastery, training/practice Scene, Project and reward authorities and establish the recognition/teaching/campaign/reward taxonomy before any ALP-01 application mutation.

boundaries: achievements are optional and not universal permission gates
unrelated capability cannot be granted by achievement implication
mechanical rewards commit through owning Reward/Progression/Reputation/Faction systems
platform learning and campaign achievements remain distinct
AI cannot silently award achievements or infer hidden completion
ALP-01 selection creates no implementation authority; ALP-02+ and VTI-01+ remain unauthorized
